summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called arginine hydrochloride to see if it helps adults with type 2 diabetes recover faster from a serious condition called diabetic ketoacidosis, where harmful acids build up in the blood due to high blood sugar. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which looks like the drug but has no active medicine, alongside their standard medical care. The study aims to enroll 60 participants to learn how the treatment affects the body's natural insulin levels and recovery time.
